---
title: Basic
---

Get started with the XR Blocks script lifecycle by interacting with a Three.js cylinder. Click on desktop, pinch with hands in XR, or use a controller trigger to dynamically change its color.

### Desktop Controls (User Mode)

- **Move Camera:** Use <kbd>W</kbd>, <kbd>A</kbd>, <kbd>S</kbd>, <kbd>D</kbd> to move forward, left, backward, and right.
- **Elevate Camera:** Use <kbd>Q</kbd> and <kbd>E</kbd> to move down and up.
- **Rotate Camera:** Right-click and drag the mouse to look around.
- **Interact:** Left-click to select the object and randomize its color.

### XR Controls

- **Interact:** Ray-pinch with hands or pull the controller trigger to change the cylinder's color.
